newsitem.title: USA: Fortune adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Fortune adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Fortune Petroleum Corp said Monday it adopted a shareholder rights plan, triggered when a shareholder purchases 15 percent of the company's stock.
The company said it is not aware of any current efforts to acquire control of the company.
The plan calls for preferred stock purchase rights to be distributed to holders of the company's common stock and will expire on February 28, 2007, the company said.

The company said the rights would be exercisable only if a party acquired beneficial ownership of 15 percent or more of Fortune's common stock, or commenced a tender offer which would result in ownership of 15 percent or more of such stock.
